description: India and Japan maintain a Special Strategic and Global Partnership supported by regular political dialogue and wide-ranging economic cooperation. This council profile focuses on the parliamentary and policy context for stronger commercial engagement between the two countries.

Priority themes include implementation of the India-Japan Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement, quality infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, clean energy, digital technologies, skills and innovation.
keyObjectives: Support informed dialogue on policies affecting bilateral trade and investment.
Highlight opportunities in infrastructure, manufacturing, clean energy and technology.
Encourage exchanges among legislators, industry representatives and knowledge institutions.

description: India and the United States have a comprehensive global strategic partnership spanning trade, technology, energy, education, defence, health and people-to-people links. This profile provides a policy-focused foundation for engagement with legislators and business stakeholders.
The council’s relevant areas of attention include regulatory cooperation, resilient supply chains, digital and emerging technologies, clean energy, investment and movement of skilled professionals.
keyObjectives: Promote structured dialogue on legislation and regulation affecting bilateral commerce.
Surface business priorities in technology, energy, manufacturing and services.
Strengthen connections among parliamentarians, enterprises and research communities.

description: India and the European Union share a strategic partnership covering trade, investment, climate action, science and technology, digital policy, connectivity and agriculture. This council profile centres on the parliamentary dimension of that broad relationship.
Its policy agenda is relevant to market access, trusted technology, standards, sustainable supply chains, research collaboration and the enabling environment for two-way investment.
keyObjectives: Encourage policy dialogue on trade, investment and standards.
Advance understanding of digital, climate and connectivity priorities.
Connect legislators with Indian and European industry stakeholders.

description: India-Canada relations draw on democratic institutions, education and research links, investment, energy cooperation and substantial people-to-people connections. This profile focuses on constructive parliamentary and economic dialogue.

Relevant themes include trade and investment facilitation, critical minerals, renewable energy, higher education, innovation, talent mobility and support for transparent, predictable commercial engagement.
keyObjectives: Build awareness of policy issues affecting businesses and investors.
Encourage cooperation in education, research, energy and critical minerals.
Support dialogue that strengthens institutional and people-to-people links.

description: India and Russia maintain a Special and Privileged Strategic Partnership with cooperation across trade, energy, science and technology, defence, connectivity, culture and people-to-people ties. This profile frames the parliamentary context for a broader and more diversified economic relationship.
Areas of attention include trade facilitation, energy security, technology partnerships, transport corridors, regional cooperation and stronger links between private-sector institutions.
keyObjectives: Support policy dialogue that enables diversified bilateral commerce.
Highlight opportunities in energy, technology, manufacturing and connectivity.
Encourage exchanges among legislators, businesses and regional institutions.

description: India and Viet Nam share a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and cooperate through political, economic, scientific, technological and regional mechanisms. This profile supports policy awareness around the expanding bilateral relationship.
Relevant themes include trade and investment, manufacturing, digital technology, agriculture, energy, maritime connectivity, skills and cooperation under India’s Act East Policy.
keyObjectives: Promote dialogue on policies that facilitate trade and investment.
Identify opportunities in manufacturing, technology, agriculture and energy.
Strengthen institutional links supporting India-Viet Nam cooperation.

description: SAARC was established to advance welfare, development and regional cooperation in South Asia. As a founding member, India supports practical cooperation that improves connectivity, infrastructure, development outcomes and people-to-people contacts.
This profile focuses on the parliamentary and policy dialogue needed for inclusive regional growth, easier movement of goods and services, resilient infrastructure and knowledge exchange.
keyObjectives: Encourage dialogue on regional connectivity and trade facilitation.
Support cooperation in development, infrastructure and skills.
Promote exchanges among South Asian legislators and business communities.

description: BRICS brings together major emerging economies through cooperation in politics and security, economy and finance, and cultural and people-to-people exchange. This profile addresses the parliamentary perspective on India’s engagement with the grouping.
Policy themes include multilateral economic cooperation, development finance, digital transformation, sustainable development, resilient supply chains and stronger institutional exchange.
keyObjectives: Build policy understanding of BRICS economic and development initiatives.
Encourage parliamentary dialogue on inclusive and sustainable growth.
Connect policy stakeholders with business and knowledge networks.

description: India and ASEAN have a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership developed through more than three decades of formal engagement. Cooperation spans trade, connectivity, maritime issues, food security, science, technology and people-to-people exchange.
This council profile focuses on the policy environment supporting India’s Act East Policy, regional value chains, digital links, physical connectivity and sustainable economic cooperation.
keyObjectives: Advance dialogue on regional trade, connectivity and supply chains.
Promote cooperation in digital technology, food security and sustainability.
Strengthen exchanges between legislators and industry across ASEAN and India.

description: India’s engagement with Latin America is supported by shared developmental priorities, South-South cooperation and growing political and economic links. The region offers diverse opportunities across energy, minerals, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, technology and manufacturing.
This profile focuses on the parliamentary relationships and policy understanding needed to expand trade, investment, knowledge exchange and direct institutional connections.
keyObjectives: Improve policy awareness of opportunities across Latin American markets.
Encourage dialogue on trade facilitation, investment and sector cooperation.
Build sustained links among legislators, businesses and institutions.

description: India and the Caribbean share democratic traditions, development priorities, cultural links and a significant Indian diaspora. Engagement with CARICOM creates a regional platform for cooperation with Caribbean states.
This profile highlights parliamentary dialogue around climate resilience, disaster management, renewable energy, digital services, healthcare, education, capacity building and trade.
keyObjectives: Promote policy exchange on climate resilience and sustainable development.
Support cooperation in technology, health, education and renewable energy.
Strengthen parliamentary, business and diaspora connections.

description: India-Africa relations combine longstanding political ties with development cooperation, capacity building, trade and investment. The partnership covers agriculture, healthcare, digital services, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, education and skills.
The council profile is designed to help businesses understand regional opportunities, connect with institutions and build commercially sustainable partnerships based on mutual benefit.
keyObjectives: Facilitate business connections across African markets and regional institutions.
Highlight opportunities in infrastructure, healthcare, agriculture, energy and digital services.
Support knowledge exchange, capacity building and responsible investment.

description: BRICS economic cooperation brings together major emerging markets with an emphasis on trade, investment, finance, sustainable development and people-to-people exchange. This profile translates that broad agenda into practical areas for enterprise engagement.
The council’s business focus includes market intelligence, development finance, innovation, digitalisation, resilient supply chains, sustainability and connections among member-country companies.
keyObjectives: Connect enterprises with BRICS trade and investment opportunities.
Promote dialogue on finance, innovation, sustainability and supply chains.
Encourage partnerships among companies and business institutions.

description: India-EU economic ties span trade, investment, technology, climate action, connectivity, agriculture and research. The Trade and Technology Council adds a structured mechanism for cooperation where commerce, trusted technology and security intersect.
This profile supports businesses navigating market access, standards, sustainability requirements, digital policy, innovation partnerships and two-way investment.
keyObjectives: Help businesses understand market access, standards and regulatory priorities.
Promote partnerships in technology, clean growth, research and connectivity.
Channel practical industry perspectives into bilateral economic dialogue.

description: India-US commercial relations are part of a comprehensive strategic partnership encompassing technology, energy, manufacturing, services, education and innovation. Strong business and people-to-people links support a wide range of cross-border opportunities.
This profile focuses on practical cooperation in investment, resilient supply chains, emerging technologies, clean energy, healthcare, skills and regulatory understanding.
keyObjectives: Facilitate connections between Indian and US enterprises and investors.
Identify barriers and opportunities affecting bilateral commerce.
Promote collaboration in technology, energy, manufacturing and services.

description: India-Russia economic cooperation operates within a longstanding strategic partnership and extends across energy, trade, science and technology, manufacturing, transport and regional connectivity. Engagement with the wider CIS region adds diverse market and logistics opportunities.

This profile focuses on expanding private-sector connections, diversifying trade, improving market intelligence and exploring corridors such as the International North-South Transport Corridor and the Chennai-Vladivostok maritime route.
keyObjectives: Expand private-sector and institutional business connections.
Support diversified trade in energy, technology, manufacturing and services.
Improve awareness of logistics, payment, standards and market-entry considerations.

description: India and France have a strategic partnership whose principal pillars include defence and security, civil nuclear cooperation and space, with expanding work in artificial intelligence, innovation, blue economy, renewable energy and sustainable development.
This profile supports commercial engagement in advanced technology, aerospace, clean energy, infrastructure, digital innovation, research and investment.
keyObjectives: Connect businesses in advanced technology, aerospace, energy and infrastructure.
Promote innovation, research partnerships and two-way investment.
Support understanding of market-entry and regulatory priorities.

description: India-Germany cooperation has strong economic, scientific and technological foundations, with trade, investment, energy, infrastructure, research, education and vocational training among its established pillars.
This profile focuses on manufacturing, green technologies, mobility, industrial research, skills, small and medium enterprises and investment partnerships.
keyObjectives: Promote industrial, technology and green-economy partnerships.
Strengthen business links in manufacturing, infrastructure and skills.
Support market intelligence and collaboration among SMEs and institutions.

description: India and the United Kingdom share a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership covering trade and prosperity, technology, health, climate action, defence, education and people-to-people links. The relationship is supported by substantial two-way business and investment.
This profile focuses on trade facilitation, investment, financial and professional services, technology, clean growth, healthcare, education and innovation.
keyObjectives: Facilitate commercial and investment connections between India and the UK.
Promote cooperation in technology, services, health and clean growth.
Help enterprises understand market-entry and regulatory considerations.

description: SAARC’s regional mandate includes economic growth, social progress and cooperation across South Asia. For business, the region’s potential is closely linked to connectivity, trade facilitation, infrastructure, energy, digital links and stronger value chains.
This profile provides a practical framework for enterprises seeking regional partnerships while recognising the varied markets and policy environments across member states.
keyObjectives: Encourage regional trade, investment and business-to-business connections.
Promote dialogue on connectivity, logistics and resilient value chains.
Share market intelligence and practical lessons across South Asia.

description: Latin America and the Caribbean comprise diverse markets connected to India through trade, investment, development cooperation, democratic values and people-to-people links. Important commercial themes include energy, minerals, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, automobiles, information technology and infrastructure.
This profile helps enterprises approach the region with better market intelligence, stronger institutional connections and an emphasis on long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships.
keyObjectives: Build business connections across Latin American and Caribbean markets.
Highlight opportunities in energy, minerals, agriculture, healthcare and technology.
Support trade facilitation, market intelligence and responsible investment.
